anomalies.description: Sudden bright vertical streaks of light and intense illumination appear in frame f11 (21.5s), consistent with a high-energy impact such as a vehicle collision involving sparks or explosion of a vehicle component (e.g., battery, fuel line) under night conditions. The scene immediately darkens afterward (f12–f15), suggesting loss of power or camera disruption due to the event.

Frame f11 shows multiple bright, upward-traveling linear plumes of light against darkness—characteristic of pyrotechnic-like ejection from a sudden energetic release (e.g., fuel-air ignition or battery thermal runaway). This is distinct from streetlights or reflections and occurs abruptly after normal driving footage. No sustained fire is visible afterward, supporting a brief explosive event rather than a fire.
A light-colored station wagon loses control on the wet/slippery road, slides sideways across multiple lanes, and collides with a dark SUV traveling in the adjacent lane.
